span.p:
Web server
[Container: nginx 1.27]
Proxies /api/ and /ws/ from the SPA

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
HTTP security chain
[Component: Spring Security 5, JJWT]
HTTPSecurityConfiguration, JWTRequestFilter,
corsFilter, JwtUtils
stateless, Bearer JWT, CORS allow-list

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
STOMP endpoint + inbound auth
[Component: Spring WebSocket, SockJS]
STOMPMessageBrokerConfiguration,
CustomInterceptor
/ws SockJS, WS-Authorization header,
in-memory simple broker

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
REST controllers
[Component: Spring MVC]
controller/** (18)
auth, profile, post, comment, like,
following, newsfeed, hashtag, chat,
notification, report, admin,
statistic, attachment

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

[Component: Spring Messaging]
ChatController @MessageMapping
/app/chat, /app/conversation,
/app/conversation/typing ...

service/impl/*ServiceImpl,
service/report/*

mapper/**

ApplicationEventPublisher,
event/handler/* @Async @EventListener
